capabilities: Translate or hide a paragraph under the pointer via hotkey in Reading view
Connect to OpenAI-compatible services, Anthropic, or Google Gemini, including local models
Configure custom languages, prompts, and models
Cache translations and preserve inline code and math
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. API tokens are stored unencrypted in data.json and may be included in vault sync; cancelling or timing out requests may still incur charges.
problem: Reading notes in a second language is hard, and translating them usually means editing the file or copying text elsewhere.

requires.name: hosted AI service account and API credits

summary: AI translation plugin that shows translations beneath original paragraphs in Reading view without modifying the underlying notes.
